segments.text: "I beg you, please be my groom!!"
Likes: Shinra

A transfer student from France, she is fluent in Japanese and has come to exterminate the witches. Blond hair, blue eyes, attractive, and outstanding figure, even though she is very earnest​ and orderly, she actually has poor sense of direction and her careless parts stand out in many ways.

Since Shinra and his childhood friends had visited the witch's house when they were young, she makes contact with them, hoping to gain more information, but before she knows it, she becomes a part of their group.

Due to her being raised in an old-fashioned family, she has a strong sense of virtue​ and thinks that she must marry the person who has seen her nakedness. Because Shinra can easily sees hers, she ardently approaches him in order to make him her groom.
Translated and edited from the official website
魔女を駆逐するためにフランスからやってきたという日本語堪能な転校生。
金髪碧眼、容姿端麗でスタイル抜群。
生真面目で整然とした性格だが、実は方向音痴だったりと色々な面でおっちょこちょいな部分が目立つ。
幼い頃に魔女の館に辿り着いたという森羅たち幼なじみ軍団から情報を探ろうと接触してくるが、いつの間にかコミュニティに加わることになる。
古風な家に育ったせいか貞操観念が強く、裸を見られた相手の嫁にならねばならないと思っている。
森羅にはあっさり裸を見られてしまったため、彼を婿に迎えようと熱烈アプローチしてくる。

Likes: A shrine maiden's duty
A member of the "Childhood Friend Corps" and the class president. She looks tidy and gives out the yamato nadeshiko vibe, but on the inside, she is a strong-willed and dependable woman.

She keeps a close watch on the perverted Shinra, and whenever he does something wild, she often scolds him. On the other hand, due to her leader-like nature, she is the type of person who tends to act on her own, in that case, on the contrary, Shinra is the one who supports her.
Because her family owns a shrine, she has been a miko since she was young. She is proud of her role as a miko, for that reason, the item she has received from the witch seems a bit dubious......?

"If you were a girl, you'd want to pamper a cute boy, wouldn't you think so?"
Likes: Pampering Shinra

Undeniably, a well-grown girl who is a part of the "Childhood Friend Corps". She is a member of the swimming club, and as a first-year student, she has already become the team's ace. However, she does not seem have any attachment to the competitions.

She has a gentle and kind personality, a girl who is truly an embodiment of motherhood. At heart, she is a firm person and excels in household chores. Ever since she was a child, she finds great joy in pampering Shinra, bringing his face to her well-grown chest, she hugs him and pats him like a child.
For some reason, she has an overactive bladder​, which is her weak point.
Translated and edited from the official website

segments.text: "I'm counting on you, my apprentice and servant, my beloved child."
Likes: Candies and sweets
Shinra's master and the master of magic "Witch of the Forest". Despite having a petite appearance, she is bossy and acting arrogantly, often using her servant Shinra, as a pawn.
A so-called "Elder Loli", most of the time, she speaks like a sage, but on the other hand, she occasionally shows a childish and innocent side, only eating sweets and then getting scolded by Homura.
Although she is always berating Shinra, she still cares and shows kindness towards him, even thinks of him as her own child.
Translated and edited from the official website

"After all, it's because I'm a genius and a lovable character!"
Likes: Cool things

A member of the "Childhood Friend Corps" as well as the science club. She is a genius first-year student who is famous for being the smartest person in the school. She has a slight chuunibyou habit, and acting frivolously in order to look cool, in spite of this, she is emotionally sensitive, but as soon as she retorts, she goes back to being a lovable character.
Having an insatiable curiosity, she often secludes herself in the science room, experimenting. Always in pursue of knowledge, she keeps reading books at the library.
Even with G-cup bountiful breasts on her small body, in addition to erotic inverted nipples, she still seems to have some concerns about it.

"What～? Were you actually eyeing up Homura～?"
Likes: Lying down and eating potato chips while watching television
A dragon girl who is a servant working for Eliska. She keeps a close watch on Shinra after he became the witch's servant. At the school, she is in the same class as him.

Like most servants, she even wears a maid's outfit during her private time, despite always having a sleepy-looking face and leading a slovenly life, she is also negligent​ and forces any hassle on Shinra. To a certain extent, she sees him as a troublesome younger brother, even though he is not her servant, she still thinks that she can use him as much as she wants.
On the other hand, since she is a dragon, she possesses an enormous strength, and in the event of an emergency, she becomes a very reliable person.

To hide the fact from other people that she is a dragon, she uses magic to conceal her horns and tail (but Shinra can see them). In fact, her horns and tail appear to be her weak point, if one were to suddenly touch them......?
Translated and edited from the official website
エリシュカの召使いをしている竜人族の少女。
魔女のドレイとなった森羅のお目付役を担っており、学園でも同じクラスに席を置いている。
召使いらしくプライベートではメイド服を着用しているわりにいつも眠そうな目つきでだらだらとした私生活を送っており、面倒事はなんでも森羅に押しつけるような自堕落気質。
森羅のことは手のかかる弟程度に捉えており、ドレイというほどでもないが好きに使って良いと思っている。
一方で竜人族のため戦闘力は高く、いざというときにはとても頼りになる存在。
竜人族であることを周囲に悟られないよう角や尻尾は魔法で隠して過ごしている（しかし森羅には見える）。
実はその角と尻尾が大の弱点らしく、ふと触ってしまうと……？

A member of the "Childhood Friend Corps". However, since she does not want to stand out like the others, she becomes a rather plain girl who has not been recognized by her surroundings. She is a member of the library committee and is always at the library counter after school.
Shy, reserved, and timid, she does her best to keep up with her assertive childhood friends, but is often gets swayed.
She has a strong odor fetish and likes the smells of the library and Shinra's. In particular, because of the protagonist's scent, she seems to have special feelings for him......

A good-looking boy who is the leader of the "Childhood Friend Corps". He was born into a family that runs a coffee shop. After school, he always wears a sommelier's outfit and devotes himself to his work.

As a child, he was everyone's leader, but after receiving a magic coffee maker from Eliska, he became absorbed in his family business. Now he settles everything with coffee, becoming a genuine coffee shop freak.
